channel.title: First Principles Daily
channel.description:
A daily narrative podcast that reasons about the world from first principles — the 'magic wand number' and the 'Idiot Index'. Episodes alternate between a concrete example of first-principles thinking in action (historical and modern — Ford, Bessemer, the shipping container, solar, batteries, and sometimes Musk's teams) and a deep exposé on an industry ripe for the same treatment.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 1: A rocket engine once priced in the millions now approaches the cost of its raw metals because its designers started from the physics instead of the parts catalog.
item.description: A rocket engine once priced in the millions now approaches the cost of its raw metals because its designers started from the physics instead of the parts catalog. Segment 1 — The Cold Open A single booster engine that once carried a price tag measured in the millions now sits at a fraction of that figure, not because a new alloy appeared or a subsidy arrived, but because the team repeatedly asked what the finished article would cost if every atom could be arranged for free. ...
